episode_title: Episode 135: Arilda Surridge is co-hosting the Therapist Evolution Summit

real_qa.q: What is the Therapist Evolution Summit and what topics does it cover for mental health professionals?
real_qa.r: The Therapist Evolution Summit is a conference being held in Seattle in August with approximately 300 attendees, featuring 18 speakers covering business growth and diversification for therapists. Topics include retreats, artificial intelligence, group practice ownership, continuing education courses, intensives, professional speaking, financial planning, book writing, marketing, and practice valuation. The summit is designed specifically for therapists wanting to develop multiple revenue streams beyond traditional therapy while maintaining their professional integrity.
real_qa.requete: Therapist Evolution Summit Seattle August topics speakers

real_qa.q: Why did Arilda Surridge create the Therapist Evolution Summit instead of just continuing retreats?
real_qa.r: Arilda wanted to spice up her life and create something new beyond her successful retreat business. After attending a symposium in Washington D.C., she conceived the idea of a larger-scale summit focused on business growth and diversification. She approached Julian to co-host because she recognized that a summit of this scale (aiming for 300 people) required collaboration and could not be managed alone, whereas her retreats had been smaller scale projects she could handle independently.
real_qa.requete: Why Arilda Surridge created Therapist Evolution Summit DC

real_qa.q: What specific presenters are speaking at the Therapist Evolution Summit and what are their topics?
real_qa.r: The 18 speakers include: Danielle Swim (keynote, entrepreneurial therapist, AI focus), Sarah Gilbert (trainings and speaking), Sherry Short (group practice ownership with multiple locations), Kajana Hawthorne (passion-driven practice), Carla Titus from Wealth and Worth Within (financial planning), Dr. Amy Isaac (professional speaking), Dr. Anna Barron (culturally sensitive practice), Charity and Morgan (intensive model), Dr. Anahita (selling a practice), Lisa Dewey (book writing), Rachel Bentley (retreat and summit planning), Caitlin Martins (team retention), Kate Fish (values-driven CEO from ACT framework), Rachel Elder (marketing and visibility), and Sarah Steele (nonprofit grant-funded immersive programs).
real_qa.requete: Therapist Evolution Summit 18 speakers list topics presenters

real_qa.q: When and where is the Therapist Evolution Summit taking place in 2025?
real_qa.r: The Therapist Evolution Summit is scheduled for August at the Seattle Convention Center. Arilda intentionally chose this location and timing because Seattle is particularly beautiful during summer, the Convention Center is centrally located with easy access to attractions like the Space Needle and Pike Place Market, and the area offers abundant accommodations and restaurants.
real_qa.requete: Therapist Evolution Summit Seattle August 2025 date location

real_qa.q: How many attendees is the Therapist Evolution Summit expecting and what networking opportunities are included?
real_qa.r: The summit is aiming for approximately 300 attendees. Beyond presentations, the event includes an opening reception, a closing dinner, intentional optional gatherings around Seattle, and a final night celebration featuring a dance floor with live performances and karaoke to encourage connection and networking among therapists.
real_qa.requete: Therapist Evolution Summit 300 attendees networking reception dinner

guest.titre: Retreat Facilitator and Co-host of the Therapist Evolution Summit
guest.bio_context: Arilda Surridge is a retreat facilitator who has been successfully organizing transformational retreats and building a community of mental health professionals. She met host Julian at one of her retreats in Bali in April 2025 (episode 106 of the Compassionate Climb podcast), and they have since collaborated extensively across multiple countries including Panama, Costa Rica, and Morocco. She is co-hosting the Therapist Evolution Summit in Seattle, a major conference designed to help therapists diversify their income streams beyond traditional clinical practice.
